Players who do not play or are not assigned a fantasy-point value by Sleeper are treated as scoring 0 fantasy points. Fantasy scoring systems may vary; these markets use Sleeper’s default full-PPR scoring. The fantasy-point total published by Sleeper at expiration is used, with no additional rounding, and corrections after expiration are not considered.

Please read the scoring format below. All values are fantasy points under Sleeper’s default full-PPR scoring.

Passing, rushing, and receiving

Passing yards: +0.04 per yard (+1 per 25 yards).
Passing touchdown: +4.
Interception thrown: −1.
Passing two-point conversion: +2.
Rushing yards: +0.1 per yard (+1 per 10 yards).
Rushing touchdown: +6.
Rushing two-point conversion: +2.
Reception: +1.
Receiving yards: +0.1 per yard (+1 per 10 yards).
Receiving touchdown: +6.
Receiving two-point conversion: +2.

Kicking

Field goal made, 0–39 yards: +3.
Field goal made, 40–49 yards: +4.
Field goal made, 50–59 yards: +5.
Field goal made, 60+ yards: +6.
Extra point made: +1.
Field goal missed: −1.
Extra point missed: −1.

Defense and special teams (D/ST)

Defensive touchdown: +6.
Sack: +1.
Interception made: +2.
Defensive fumble recovery: +2.
Forced fumble: +1.
Safety: +2.
Blocked kick: +2.
Special-teams touchdown: +6.
Special-teams forced fumble: +1.
Special-teams fumble recovery: +1.

D/ST points allowed per game

0 points allowed: +10.
1–6 points allowed: +7.
7–13 points allowed: +4.
14–20 points allowed: +1.
21–27 points allowed: 0.
28–34 points allowed: −1.
35+ points allowed: −4.

Individual-player special teams and fumbles
Special-teams touchdown: +6.
Fumble: 0.
Fumble lost: −2.
Fumble-recovery touchdown: +6.
